title: Network Participation Agreements: Days Remaining to Termination and the Exit Recovery Share
content:
**Rule.** The closer a Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements** is to its termination date, the less of its open receivable the remaining capitation can be expected to recover. The exit timing points are set by the days from today to the termination date:

- 60 days or fewer subtract 10 share points from the exit recovery share;
- more than 60 and at most 90 days subtract 5 share points;
- more than 90 days subtract nothing.

## Counting the days

Days are calendar days from today to the termination date shown on the agreement record. Today is not counted; the termination date is.

## Band table

| Days from today to the termination date | Share points subtracted |
|---|---|
| 60 or fewer | 10 |
| 61 to 90 | 5 |
| 91 or more | Nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Termination date 60 days away: 10 points.
- 61 days away: 5 points.
- 90 days away: 5 points.
- 91 days away: nothing.
